name: VIGIL follow-up
about: Track independently actionable repository work, not routine Incident uncertainty
title: '[VIGIL follow-up][category] '
labels: []

---

## Category

Choose one: taxonomy-gap / evidence-required / record-maintenance / system-improvement.

## Affected record and scope

Incident ID, episode IDs, Fidelity Class or requirement IDs, current branch and exact revision.

## Established evidence and limitations

Link public, attributable sources. State observed facts separately from interpretations and note unavailable decisive evidence. Do not include private information.

## Issue admission (all four conditions must hold)

- [ ] This is a distinct task beyond normal Incident adjudication or the current PR.
- [ ] There is an identified realistic execution path and actor with the required access.
- [ ] Completion can be verified by specified evidence or a concrete test/diff.
- [ ] It belongs to a separate actionable workstream, not the current decision packet/PR.

If any box cannot be checked, **do not create an Issue**. Record contested criteria, missing private source evidence or a justified classification hold in the Incident and dated review. Unknown vendor internals or allowlisting without a realistic acquisition route are not open work.

## Exact actionable defect or task

Describe the independently executable defect or work, and why it is outside the present authorised PR. Do not list mere missing recognition evidence as an Issue.

## Execution route and owner

Name the source/access path or affected repository component and who can perform this with current authority.

## Proposed next action

A concrete, smallest viable public-source retrieval, repository correction or implementation task.

## Dependencies and approval

Identify existing related issues/PRs, necessary maintainer authorisation and any blockers.

## Closure criteria

Specify verifiable evidence or test results **reasonably achievable with known access**. No open-ended dependency on vendor internals, access approval or indefinite future disclosure. An issue does not authorise a schema, taxonomy or validator change.
